w0_metadata_reconciliation.reconciliation_resolution: Both results/math_and_readability_oracle.json and results/parity_telemetry.json in scene3d-architecture-visual-reliability cover all 11 locked fixtures identically.

resolutions.title: veKhongGian transforms o.perpendicular_witness alongside o.annotation.witness and is idempotent
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix: Extracted shared nhanChung(w, T) helper in scene3d-chart.ts so both o.annotation.witness and o.perpendicular_witness have foot mapped by nhan(T, w.foot) and marker mapped by { ...w.marker, dinh: nhan(T, w.foot), u: donVi(nhan(T, w.marker.u)), v: donVi(nhan(T, w.marker.v)) }. Added WeakSet<Scene3D> idempotency guard (_daVe) so repeated veKhongGian calls (e.g. Scene3DExplorer -> Scene3DWorkspace) do not re-apply T while keeping chart_metric intact for maTranKhung4.

resolutions.title: Target carrier lines of perpendicular_witness stay visible at final step under aux=0, while disposable planes and off-solid translated auxiliary points (H, H1) hide after their target plane is constructed
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix:
1. In auxiliaryObjects (scene3d-auxiliary.ts), collected duongChieu = Set of all o.perpendicular_witness.on target line IDs and excluded them from disposable loai='dung' classification, so gt_g and derived_H_line remain visible at the final step under default aux=0 while mp1_gt_g and mp2_gt_g still hide after gt_g is constructed.
2. Included off-solid translated auxiliary points (point3 with origin='derived', single role CONSTRUCT_AUXILIARY_GEOMETRY, no perpendicular_witness, depending on a vector3, whose non-sub-entity semantic dependents !x.parent are all plane3) in loai='dung' with xongTai = step of the plane3, so H and H1 hide once the cutting plane is built.
3. Filtered !anPhu.has(o.id) in coMatNhan, diemNen, and nhanDiem in scene3d-view.tsx so hidden auxiliary points do not leave orphan labels or inflate bounding boxes.

resolutions.title: Harness applies withSubEntities by default; unselected face sub-entities act as transparent hit proxies; section sub-entities respect progressive geometry_progress and deduplicate named vertices
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix:
1. Enabled withSubEntities(daVe, objectsAt) by default in hybrid-section-visual.tsx (with sub=0 opt-out).
2. Assigned display_role='hit_proxy' to unselected face sub-entities when their parent solid/section is rendered and un-exploded, and configured buildObject3D to render unselected hit_proxy faces with colorWrite=false, depthWrite=false, opacity=0 (raycastable without double-tinting solid/section faces).
3. Gated section sub-entities (td::face:0, td::edge:i, td::vertex:i) on parent geometry_progress (progressCha.closed && progressCha.fill_visible, visible_edge_ids) and skipped unselected section ::vertex:i sub-entities that coincide with already-rendered named points.

resolutions.title: Harness exposes learner timeline selector (Bước học) mapped via anchorOfGeometryStep alongside raw step slider
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix: Added learner step combobox (aria-label='Bước học', data-testid='learner-step-select') and lstep URL parameter in hybrid-section-visual.tsx using geometryStepCount, geometryStepOf, and anchorOfGeometryStep, plus Hình phụ checkbox toggle.

resolutions.title: result-binding-visual-check.mjs verifies Product-default aux=0 first and then tests Hình phụ toggle (aux=1)
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix: Removed hardcoded &aux=1 from default load in result-binding-visual-check.mjs; added explicit assertions that under default aux=0 the target carrier line (gt_g) and foot (H) remain rendered while auxiliary planes (mp1_gt_g, mp2_gt_g) are hidden in auxiliaryHiddenIds, followed by toggling Hình phụ to verify aux=1.

resolutions.title: Passive plane patch opacity reduced to 0.10, defining-point frame used for surface planes, and PLANE_PATCH_MIN_SIZE floor removed when banKinh > 0
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix:
1. In khungMatPhang (scene3d-model.ts:905), used 2 * banKinh * PLANE_PATCH_MARGIN whenever banKinh > 0 instead of clamping up to PLANE_PATCH_MIN_SIZE (2.5).
2. In scene3d-view.tsx, scoped reference points for surface plane patches to their finite defining points or section polygon vertices (diemMp) when >= 3 points exist, and reduced passive surface plane opacity from 0.16 to 0.10 (active 0.32).

resolutions.title: Coincident points render combined 'B ≡ H' label without overlap, and harness selection details fall back cleanly across label/notation/id
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix:
1. Added kyHieuDiem(o, tatCaDiem) in scene3d-presentation.ts to combine coincident visible points (distance <= 1e-3) into 'B ≡ H' (prioritizing given vertices before derived points).
2. Updated nhanDiem in scene3d-view.tsx to use kyHieuDiem and updated hybrid-section-visual.tsx selection details to [o.label || o.notation || o.id, o.role].filter(Boolean).join(' · ').

resolutions.title: Frontend scene3d-auxiliary.ts distinguishes perpendicular_witness target carrier lines from disposable auxiliary scaffolding without altering locked backend Scene IR
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix: Inspecting o.perpendicular_witness.on across scene.objects in auxiliaryObjects decouples target carrier lines from disposable scaffolding purely in frontend presentation while keeping backend Scene IR and candidate 30808cb0… backend files 100% untouched.

resolutions.title: Harness matches Product sub-entity and auxiliary pipeline at identical camera pose and FOV
resolutions.mechanism_of_fix: With withSubEntities enabled by default and learner timeline + Hình phụ controls exposed in hybrid-section-visual.tsx, Product and Harness render identical object and sub-entity sets (after_same_all_rendered_objects: true across all 9 harness cases).
